title: NuviraMC
description: NuviraMC ist dein Minecraft-Netzwerk mit einer riesigen Auswahl an spannenden Spielmodi.
body: NuviraMC is a Minecraft server featuring SMP and CityBuild, where players can build, trade, and progress in a balanced economy. With systems like claims, jobs, custom items, and more, there is always something to work toward. The server supports Java and Bedrock Edition. Join at NuviraMC.net.
